assertions.description: congestionControl is exposed as an attribute on WebTransport.prototype.
The attribute is a readonly accessor: a getter function with no setter on the prototype descriptor.
assertions.test: (() => { if (typeof WebTransport !== 'function') return false; const d = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(WebTransport.prototype, 'congestionControl'); return !!d && typeof d.get === 'function' && d.set === undefined; })()

assertions.description: [[CongestionControl]] is initialised at construction: the attribute is readable (one of the three enum values) on a session that has not established — and never 'pending'.
assertions.test: (() => { if (typeof WebTransport !== 'function' || !('congestionControl' in WebTransport.prototype)) return false; const t = new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never'); t.ready.catch(() => {}); t.closed.catch(() => {}); const v = t.congestionControl; t.close(); return v === 'default' || v === 'throughput' || v === 'low-latency'; })()

assertions.description: Requesting 'default' always reads back 'default' — the fallback rule only applies to non-default requests.
assertions.test: (() => { if (typeof WebTransport !== 'function' || !('congestionControl' in WebTransport.prototype)) return false; const t = new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never', { congestionControl: 'default' }); t.ready.catch(() => {}); t.closed.catch(() => {}); const v = t.congestionControl; t.close(); return v === 'default'; })()

assertions.description: A 'throughput' or 'low-latency' request reads back either the same value (honored) or 'default' (the spec's mandated downgrade when no optimizing algorithm exists) — never anything else.
assertions.test: (() => { if (typeof WebTransport !== 'function' || !('congestionControl' in WebTransport.prototype)) return false; const check = (pref) => { const t = new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never', { congestionControl: pref }); t.ready.catch(() => {}); t.closed.catch(() => {}); const v = t.congestionControl; t.close(); return v === pref || v === 'default'; }; return check('throughput') && check('low-latency'); })()

assertions.description: An invalid WebTransportCongestionControl string in the options dictionary throws a TypeError at construction (Web IDL enum conversion).
assertions.test: (() => { if (typeof WebTransport !== 'function' || !('congestionControl' in WebTransport.prototype)) return false; try { const t = new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never', { congestionControl: 'fastest' }); t.ready.catch(() => {}); t.closed.catch(() => {}); t.close(); return false; } catch (e) { return e instanceof TypeError; } })()
